title: EthereumLearner
tagline: Learn Ethereum, Bitcoin, blockchain; then teach, consult.
description:
Newbie just starting to learn about blockchain, Bitcoin, and Ethereum. Focus on development using blockchain, not trading or cryptocurrency.

2020/10/23: As noted earlier, I'm just starting to learn about blockchain, Bitcoin, and Ethereum from the POV of a developer (not a trader) and do not plan to submit a project. I've signed up for a judging slot to be complete (Sat, 12:30 PM EDT) but do not have anything to present. Please feel free to cancel the slot. If you want me to appear then, it will be to say that I have found the entire Hackathon quite useful as part of my introduction, especially the various talks, comments on Discord, and the demo coaching sessions! I look forward to seeing the final projects. Very well run! Thank you!
